summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment to establish strict limits on federal campaign contributions and spending, prohibit corporate political spending, mandate a public financing system for federal elections, and allow states to regulate campaign finance in state and local elections.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly requires Congress to develop a system of public campaign financing for federal candidates, which would involve government expenditure. This is a central component of the proposed constitutional amendment.

The bill is primarily focused on campaign finance reform, which directly impacts the electoral process by setting limits on contributions and spending, prohibiting corporate spending, and introducing public financing. These measures are intended to protect the integrity of the electoral process and advance political equality.

The amendment mandates creation of a public campaign financing system covering at least 80% of allowable candidate spending, which would require new federal outlays without any offsetting revenue or spending cuts mentioned.

This constitutional amendment is devoted entirely to imposing strict contribution and spending caps, banning corporate political expenditures, and establishing public financing, directly advancing tighter limits on political money.
